Process & Operational Excellence

Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• On the backend, you're strong with Python and have experience with Django, FastAPI, or Flask.

• You're comfortable with data modeling across both relational and NoSQL databases.

• Working with Docker and in containerized environments like Kubernetes feels like second nature to you.

• You already work AI-natively, or you have a clear enthusiasm and fluency for that way of working.

Nice to Have

• It's a bonus if you've built agentic or LLM features into a product: things like RAG, vector search, structured extraction, or agent tool-calling, even if just through side projects.

• Experience with AWS (especially EKS), CI/CD ownership, and observability tools is definitely a plus.

• A background in enterprise B2B SaaS is great, especially if it's in logistics or supply chain.

Our Stack

About the role

Plan Left is hiring a Video Editor to turn our long-form content (webinars, podcasts, interviews and talks) into short, scroll-stopping clips that grow our B2B audience. You'll work closely with the marketing team, owning the edit from raw recording to platform-ready video for LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels.

This is a marketing role as much as an editing role: we want someone who knows what makes a business audience stop, watch and click.

What you'll do

• Review webinars, podcasts and recorded talks (30-90 minutes) and pull the strongest moments into short clips (15-90 seconds)

• Produce 15-25 short-form videos per week from each long-form piece, plus highlight reels and trailers

• Write or refine hooks, on-screen text, captions and titles that land with business buyers

• Format and optimize every clip for its platform: LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok and paid ads

• Add motion graphics, subtitles, b-roll, branded intros and lower thirds consistent with our brand guidelines

• Partner with marketing to align clips with campaigns, product launches and demand-gen goals

• Track clip performance (views, watch time, engagement, clicks) and use it to improve the next batch

• Keep an organized library of source files, templates and finished assets

The creative side

We don't want clips that look like a webinar recording with captions slapped on. We want short-form content with a point of view that feels native to each platform and still fits a credible B2B brand.

You'll get creative ownership to:

•
Find the story. Spot the surprising stat, the contrarian opinion or the honest moment in an hour of talk, then build a clip with a clear beginning, tension and payoff

•
Hook in the first 2 seconds. Try cold opens, pattern interrupts, bold text and smart reordering so viewers keep watching

•
Bring talking heads to life. Use punch-ins, jump cuts, b-roll, kinetic typography, emoji and icon callouts, split screens and simple animations to keep the energy up

•
Use sound well. Pick music, sound effects and pacing that match the mood, from punchy and fast to calm and authoritative

•
Develop a visual style. Help shape and evolve recognizable templates, caption styles, color treatments and series formats for our channels

•
Pitch new formats. Suggest series, recurring segments, carousel-to-video ideas and trend-based edits that suit a B2B audience

•
Experiment and learn. Test different hooks, lengths, aspect ratios and styles, and double down on what works

We'd love to see you add your own taste to the work. Bring ideas, not just edits.

What we're looking for

Listed in order of priority.

•
Fluent English. Excellent written and spoken English. You'll write captions, hooks and on-screen copy, and you need to catch the nuance in what speakers say to find the best moments.

•
Marketing experience. 2+ years editing video for a marketing team or agency. You understand hooks, audience retention, calls to action and how content supports a funnel.

•
Long-form to short-form repurposing. A proven track record of turning webinars, podcasts or interviews into short clips. Your portfolio should show both the source and the clips you cut from it.

•
B2B marketing content. Experience editing for B2B brands such as SaaS, professional services or tech. You know how to make expert conversations engaging for decision-makers without losing credibility.

title: Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment
description:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Rohlik is transforming how people buy food - faster, smarter, and with an obsession for quality. Czech Republic is our largest and most complex market, serving over a million customers across Europe. Now we’re looking for a Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment who will take full ownership of product availability, inventory performance, supplier reliability and automation - and lead our supply chain into its next stage of growth.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Real impact from day one - You’ll own the supply chain for our biggest market, directly shaping the experience of millions of customers.

- No corporate red tape - Fast decisions, no waiting around for HQ approvals. Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately.

- Deliberately hands-on - You won’t just sit back and set strategy in presentations; you will build the reporting, analyze the KPIs, and actively improve how the department works.

- AI-first tech stack - You’ll have access to top-notch tools and the freedom to use technology pragmatically to automate manual work.

- Lead from the front - You’ll lead a tight-knit team of max 10 people. This is a role for someone who wants to make things move fast and be in the trenches with their team.

- You’ll work closely with C-level leadership, Tech, Category and Operations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment, you own the performance across all fulfillment centers and categories. We expect you to be highly independent, tech-capable, and continuously looking to improve your own knowledge.

You will:

- Run the day-to-day operations: You will lead the morning calls, dive deep into the daily metrics, and own KPIs such as availability, stock health, shrink, and OTIF.

- Lead and build the team: Manage a small team of 8 people. You will guide and mentor them, but you are also close enough to the work to do it yourself when that is the fastest way to get things done.

- Analyze and report: You won't wait for others to hand you insights. You will build your own reporting, analyze the KPIs, and use raw data to make smarter, faster decisions.

- Drive efficiency and automation: Work actively with AI and modern tools to remove inefficiencies, automate ordering exceptions, and optimize how the function operates. You aren't just managing the process; you are rebuilding it to be better.

- Continuously learn: You don't need to know everything on day one, but you must work tirelessly to acquire new knowledge, understand the tech, and improve the company. We move fast, and you will need to adapt and grow just as quickly

WHAT YOU BRING

We are not looking for decades of extensive senior leadership experience. We are looking for a sharp, driven professional who wants to build, optimize, and learn at lightning speed. You will balance strategy with hands-on execution.

- 3+ years of experience in supply chain, retail, logistics, or operations. You have the foundational knowledge of ordering, inventory management, and KPIs-and the relentless drive to learn the rest. Understanding of fresh/chilled/dry supply chains is an advantage.

- A hands-on, builder mindset. You are as comfortable leading a team as you are diving into raw data to fix a broken process.

- Tech-capable and AI-curious. You are highly proficient with data and eager to use AI and modern tools to automate manual work. You want to use technology to actually solve problems, not just talk about them.

- Ownership and drive. You set baselines, take responsibility, hit deadlines, and proactively look for ways to improve yourself and your department. You believe "better done than perfect" beats waiting for the perfect slide deck.

title: Server Specialist
description:
Role Profile - Server Specialist
Job Summary
The Server Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining server infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability. This role involves managing physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and related technologies, while providing technical expertise and support to internal teams.
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, and maintain Windows/Linux servers and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

• Monitor server performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement corrective actions.

• Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.

• Perform regular backups and disaster recovery planning.

• Apply security patches and updates to maintain compliance.

• Collaborate with network and application teams for system integration.

• Document configurations, processes, and troubleshooting steps.

• Provide Tier 2/3 support for server-related incidents.

• Plan and execute server migrations and upgrades.

• Implement and maintain high-availability and failover solutions.

• Monitor and optimize resource utilization across servers and storage.

• Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and industry standards.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts for routine tasks (PowerShell, Bash).

• Participate in capacity planning and forecasting for server infrastructure.

• Assist in cloud integration and hybrid environment management (Azure/AWS).

• Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and remediation.

• Train and mentor junior IT staff on server technologies and best practices.

• Prepare reports on server health, performance, and utilization for management.

Required Knowledge

• Operating Systems: Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Red Hat).

• Virtualization: VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V.

• Storage: SAN/NAS technologies, RAID configurations.

• Networking Basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls.

• Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS (preferred).

• Security: Server hardening, patch management, antivirus solutions.

• Backup & Recovery: Veeam, Commvault, or similar tools.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in server administration.

• Experience in managing enterprise-level infrastructure.

• Proven track record in troubleshooting complex server issues.

• Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem management).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Bash) for automation.

• Team-oriented with the ability to work independently.

• Certifications (Preferred)

• Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.

• VMware Certified Professional (VCP).

• CompTIA Server+ or equivalent.
